stem: The ground-state configuration of chromium is $\ce{[Ar]}\,3d^5 4s^1$, not $\ce{[Ar]}\,3d^4 4s^2$. Which statement best explains this?

options.A: Electrons in the 4s orbital repel each other less than electrons in separate 3d orbitals
options.B: 3d and 4s are close in energy and moving one electron from 4s to 3d gives a half-filled 3d sub-shell with no pairing, lowering inter-electron repulsion
options.C: The 4s sub-shell of chromium can hold only one electron
options.D: 3d is lower in energy than 4s in every atom so 3d fills completely before 4s

stem: Sulfur has a lower first ionisation energy than phosphorus. Which statement explains this?

options.B: The 3p electron removed from sulfur is paired with another electron in the same orbital, and the repulsion between them makes it easier to remove
options.C: Sulfur has a smaller nuclear charge than phosphorus
options.D: The electron removed from sulfur comes from the 3s sub-shell
